own_solution.law: The Born rule gives P = integral from x1 to x1+w of (2/L) sin^2(n*pi*x/L) dx = w/L - [sin(2*n*pi*(x1+w)/L) - sin(2*n*pi*x1/L)]/(2*n*pi).
assumptions: The stated stationary state describes the electron immediately before the current position measurement.
The probe measures whether the electron lies within its response interval.
Moving the response-window edge changes the integration interval without changing the well or prepared state.
